objects.text: XT1 receives 24 V DC from PS1. B1 and B2 report slide position. Four outputs command isolated pilot interfaces.
SLIDE POSITION SENSORS · B1 AND B2
B1 and B2 report the two end positions separately. Mounting, target geometry and motion timing remain unassigned.
XT2 exposes the isolated normally open vacuum demand contact. The valve and its electrical supply remain external.
XT3 exposes the isolated normally open release demand contact. PLC sequencing and pilot interlocking remain unassigned.
W-01 carries the feed and DI a.2 return for an external contact that closes at the required vacuum. Sensor selection and threshold remain unassigned.
W-02 carries the feed and DI a.3 return for an external air-pressure-ready contact. The switch, pressure threshold and PLC response remain unassigned.
XT6 carries the extend contact to the opposite-command inhibit sheet. The directional valve and coil supply remain external.
XT7 carries the retract contact to the opposite-command inhibit sheet. Motion sequencing remains unassigned.
SLIDE OPPOSITE-COMMAND INHIBIT · K5 AND K6
Each asserted command opens the opposite pilot path after relay operation. Transition timing and safety functions remain outside this schematic.
XT9 marks the incoming L, N and PE boundary. PS1 feeds XT1. Upstream protection, conductor sizing remain unassigned.
XT10 branches incoming PE to the controller enclosure terminal and the remote assembly. Physical bonds remain unassigned.
REMOTE VALVE AND SLIDE PROTECTIVE EARTH · XT11
XT11 continues the incoming PE to the valve enclosure and slide frame terminals. Physical bonds and conductor sizes remain unassigned.
LOCAL START AND OPERATIONAL STOP · S1 AND S2
W-03 carries the feed and both request inputs. S1 closes DI a.4 and S2 opens DI a.5 when pressed. Emergency-stop functions remain outside this drawing.
POSITION SENSOR FEED TEST ACCESS · XT12
X26 disconnects the B1 and B2 feed. X27 and X28 expose the downstream +24 V and 0 V reference. Test equipment and procedures remain unassigned.
X29 and X30 open the respective extend and retract coil commands. X31 and X32 expose the downstream signals. Physical energy isolation remains outside this drawing.
PNEUMATIC PICK-AND-PLACE · WIRED PLC I/O SCHEDULE
Revision snapshot of wired hardware channels. PLC addresses, program logic and timing remain unassigned.
